def squash(s: str) -> str:
    """Compress s by run-length encoding runs of 3+ and escaping digits/backslashes."""
    out: list[str] = []
    n = len(s)
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        ch = s[i]
        j = i + 1
        while j < n and s[j] == ch:
            j += 1
        count = j - i
        escaped = f"\\{ch}" if ("0" <= ch <= "9" or ch == "\\") else ch
        out.append(f"{count}{escaped}" if count >= 3 else escaped * count)
        i = j
    return "".join(out)
